scientific_integrity: Original vector field and the existence of the two equilibrium circles are attributed to Sambas et al. (2019). Novelty remains subject to independent historical scrutiny. Analytic proof supports the continuum statement; computations are checks only.
scientific_limitations: Only smooth non-origin equilibrium points and linear transverse eigenvalues. No nonlinear center, attraction, global chaos, or origin Jacobian is claimed.
title: A cusp and complete transverse spectral phase diagram for two touching equilibrium circles
